title: Timeline swimlane
summary: The timeline as a swimlane: time runs left to right, one lane per kind of entry (or per actor), a glyph and a time label per entry, the outage windows as bands, deploys and alerts as vertical ticks, the timestamps as dashed rules. Hover a mark for the entry and the Slack message it cites; click it to jump to the row. The wheel zooms, dragging pans, and a Reset control returns to the incident's span. The page renders one at the head of Timeline when the retro has eight or more entries; declare one to switch to actor lanes, fix the span, or restrict the kinds.
belongs: Timeline. A declared one with a narrow span also fits a cause card that argues about a few minutes.

from.description: start of the resting view; default the first in-incident entry or onset

to.description: end of the resting view; default the last in-incident entry or all clear

windows.description: paint the outage windows as bands; default true

zoom.description: wheel and drag zoom; default true
